\subsection{Purpose}




This document is the final consistency audit before converting the research system into application materials.




It checks whether the strategy files from \texttt{00} to \texttt{15} are coherent, actionable, and safe to use publicly. It does not rewrite the CV, LinkedIn, GitHub, portfolio, or outreach messages yet.




The goal is to identify:




\begin{itemize}
\item what is already closed;
\item what is still uncertain;
\item what requires external verification;
\item what requires user confirmation;
\item what should be produced next;
\item what should not be claimed publicly;
\item what could create legal, credibility, or execution risk.
\end{itemize}

\section{4. Claims audit}




\subsection{Safe public claims}




These can be used in CV, LinkedIn, GitHub, portfolio, and interviews if factually true:




\begin{itemize}
\item Unity WebGL technical visualization prototype.
\item Real-time 3D drone assembly inspection.
\item CAD-to-realtime asset optimization.
\item C\# runtime interaction systems.
\item Component selection and technical UI.
\item Exploded view and cross-section/clipping.
\item Visual modes for inspection.
\item Blender-based optimization and asset preparation.
\item Thesis completed, pending defense.
\item Academic usability evaluation if final data is confirmed.
\item AI-assisted implementation under human technical ownership.
\item Python automation prototype through ARA.
\end{itemize}

\subsection{Claims to avoid}




Do not claim:




\begin{itemize}
\item “Senior Technical Artist.”
\item “EU work authorization” before passport/residence exists.
\item “German work authorization” before residence title exists.
\item “Certified Unity Developer” unless certified.
\item “Certified Rebelway / CG Cookie” if no certificate exists.
\item “Production AI engineer.”
\item “Enterprise-ready AI platform.”
\item “Commercially shipped Unity product” unless true.
\item “All code written manually” if AI assistance was used.
\item “AI built the project” because it undermines technical ownership.
\item “Full-stack specialist” as main positioning.
\end{itemize}

\section{17. Go / no-go checklist before applying}




\subsection{Go if}




\begin{itemize}
\item CV base ready.
\item One role-specific CV ready.
\item LinkedIn updated.
\item TwinSight case study shareable.
\item GitHub cleaned.
\item Portfolio MVP or case-study page exists.
\item Application tracker ready.
\item Work authorization statement clear.
\item Salary expectation prepared.
\item AI disclosure prepared.
\end{itemize}




\subsection{No-go if}




\begin{itemize}
\item thesis still described incorrectly.
\item ARA is still presented as thesis.
\item GitHub front page looks unfocused.
\item portfolio has no TwinSight case study.
\item no demo/screenshots exist.
\item EU authorization is overstated.
\item contractor setup is misunderstood.
\item CV targets too many unrelated roles.
\end{itemize}
